title: Cubic Fmpz Closure Acceptance
objective: Prove and execute the complete 83-function complex-cubic fmpz closure, including atomic rejection, five exact mathematical cases, authenticated replay extension, and sanitizer lifecycle evidence

handoff.summary: Pinned the live 83-function/187-edge complex-cubic closure, its 22-public/61-private export policy, direct fmpz calls on every internal edge, absence of mpz bridges from every fmpz body, and atomic whole-closure rejection. Executed five mathematical regimes through the authenticated production .fmpz entry with production-sized buffers, including the refined h=42 proof and an 8615-bit unit, around a deterministic decline in one process. Added 3.1.12763.1 to independent ordinary exact receipt replay.
risks: The v38 full cubic receipt suite was run with SAGEJS_HYPERELLIPTIC_AUTO_RECEIPT_POLICY=off to isolate known unrelated checked-in hyperelliptic source-bundle drift introduced by the compiler change; this lane does not edit or regenerate those artifacts.

The complete 15.4 MB cubic core is not rebuilt under sanitizers in this focused test. It proves generated checkpoint guards/cleanup structurally and exercises success-decline-success in the production addon; lower-level fmpz allocator and resource sanitizer tests remain the C-safety oracle.
next_steps: Regenerate or otherwise resolve the unrelated checked-in hyperelliptic source bundle in its owning lane before the combined unisolated runtime gate.
Run the final platform matrix and controlled opt-VM corpus timing after integration.
